WHAT THE MONEY BUYS

XERJ Query-1 is a neurosymbolic model that compiles a search prompt into a short program the engine runs over your data and shows step by step. It was trained in FP16 on GPUs rented by the hour on Clore.ai, chosen by measured throughput per dollar, plus a few machines of our own. So far that cost thousands of dollars, not millions, and it was paid for by donations.

The next training program is our estimate, not a measured number: about 100,000 H100 GPU-hours. It buys larger training worlds, robustness to fresh question wordings, sums and thresholds in the program vocabulary, fewer declined questions, and re-scoring on sealed evaluation sets. We publish every run and every score, including the ones we withdraw.

00 · TRY IT Run rc.101 with the model

Install the engine, add the model bundle, ask it questions over your own facts. The trace is the product.

A wrong answer, a confusing doc, an install that stalls: open a GitHub issue with the request and the response.

The engine is Apache-2.0. Fixes, docs and benchmarks land through ordinary pull requests.
